name: cmdk
description: Fast, unstyled command menu React component.
readme: ⌘K is a command menu React component that can also be used as an accessible combobox. You render items, it filters and sorts them automatically. ⌘K supports a fully composable API How? , so you can wrap items in other components or even as static JSX. All parts forward props, including ref, to an appropriate element. Each part has a specific data-attribute (starting with cmdk-) that can be used for styling.
